$comment: Default tuning for domed stones (the cabochon). The built-in numbers, repeated: without target_active_seconds a cut takes 3.6 seconds of steady grinding per region; tolerance_scale scales every depth window; force_window is the comfortable share of the quill's travel; sweep_tolerance the sideways handle speed (lap widths per second) before the stone rocks. Cuts may name their own profile with "work_profile".
